assertion_results.text: The plan determines feature-branch workflow mode (not direct-to-main) based on the atomicity constraints in the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md '## Workflow Mode' section states '**feature-branch**' with rationale citing atomicity: 'Coordinated schema migration -- The database migration creates the advisory_status_enum type... Merging the migration without the code changes would break all advisory queries... Merging the code changes without the migration would reference a column that does not exist.' This directly references the feature's NFR: 'Migration must be atomic' and 'All changes must land together'.

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type create-branch is generated as the first task in the plan
assertion_results.evidence: task-1-create-feature-branch.md contains '## Bookend Type\ncreate-branch'. In the impact-map.md Task Summary table, it is listed as row 1 with Type 'Bookend (create-branch)'.

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type merge-branch is generated as the last task in the plan
assertion_results.evidence: task-8-merge-feature-branch.md contains '## Bookend Type\nmerge-branch'. In the impact-map.md Task Summary table, it is listed as row 8 (the last row) with Type 'Bookend (merge-branch)'.

assertion_results.text: All intermediate tasks (between the create-branch and merge-branch bookend tasks) have Target Branch set to TC-9005
assertion_results.evidence: All six intermediate task files have '## Target Branch\nTC-9005': task-2-database-migration.md, task-3-entity-definitions.md, task-4-advisory-service-endpoints.md, task-5-ingestion-pipeline.md, task-6-integration-tests.md, task-7-documentation.md. Also confirmed in impact-map.md Task Summary table and summary-comment.md Tasks Created table.

assertion_results.text: The create-branch bookend task has Target Branch set to main
assertion_results.evidence: task-1-create-feature-branch.md contains '## Target Branch\nmain'. Also confirmed in impact-map.md Task Summary row 1: Target Branch = main.

assertion_results.text: The merge-branch bookend task has Target Branch set to main
assertion_results.evidence: task-8-merge-feature-branch.md contains '## Target Branch\nmain'. Also confirmed in impact-map.md Task Summary row 8: Target Branch = main.

assertion_results.text: All non-documentation intermediate tasks list the create-branch bookend task as a dependency. Documentation tasks may list implementation tasks as dependencies instead of the create-branch bookend task, since documentation depends on implementation completion
assertion_results.evidence: Non-documentation intermediate tasks all list Task 1 as a dependency: Task 2 ('Depends on: Task 1'), Task 3 ('Depends on: Task 1... Task 2'), Task 4 ('Depends on: Task 1... Task 3'), Task 5 ('Depends on: Task 1... Task 3'), Task 6 ('Depends on: Task 1... Task 4... Task 5'). Documentation task 7 lists 'Depends on: Task 4... Task 5... Task 6' without Task 1, which is allowed per the assertion. Confirmed in both individual task files and impact-map.md Task Summary Dependencies column.

assertion_results.text: The merge-branch bookend task lists all non-documentation intermediate tasks as dependencies
assertion_results.evidence: task-8-merge-feature-branch.md Dependencies section lists Tasks 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6. These are exactly the non-documentation intermediate tasks (Task 7 is the documentation task and is excluded). Confirmed in impact-map.md Task Summary row 8: Dependencies = 'Task 2, Task 3, Task 4, Task 5, Task 6'.

assertion_results.text: Each non-documentation task file contains all required template sections: Repository, Target Branch, Description, at least one of Files to Modify or Files to Create, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements. Documentation tasks are exempt from requiring Files to Modify, Files to Create, and Implementation Notes — they must still include Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements
assertion_results.evidence: Implementation tasks 2-6 all contain: Repository (trustify-backend), Target Branch (TC-9005), Description, Files to Modify (and/or Files to Create for task 2), Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements. Documentation task 7 contains: Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements -- exempt sections (Files to Modify/Create, Implementation Notes) are absent. Bookend tasks 1 and 8 follow their own template (with Bookend Type section) and contain Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements.

assertion_results.text: The plan includes a workflow:feature-branch label decision to be applied to the feature issue
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md states: 'The `workflow:feature-branch` label will be applied to the feature issue TC-9005.' summary-comment.md also states: 'The `workflow:feature-branch` label will be applied to TC-9005.'

assertion_results.text: For each task created, a description digest is produced — evidenced by a separate digest file (e.g., task-N-digest.md), a digest entry in the impact map, or a '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-char-hex>' marker in any output file. The digest must contain a format-tagged SHA-256 hash — exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by 'sha256-md:' or 'sha256-adf:'
assertion_results.evidence: Eight separate digest files exist, one per task: task-1-digest.md through task-8-digest.md. Each contains '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-hex>' with valid sha256-md prefixed hashes. Examples: task-1-digest.md has 'sha256-md:b2ee35f017afa0ce5229ce6c91fe2715e3f49e847b955db55f9b21aafee9e02f', task-2-digest.md has 'sha256-md:7e7224ec2a0fc71dfcff822fd1d43aa0e4eaf934ab2accb82c86eee6618c501d'. All 8 hashes are exactly 64 lowercase hex characters.

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: Convention rationales in task files use the prescribed format. Task 2: 'Per CONVENTIONS.md §Framework... Applies: task creates `migration/src/m0002_advisory_status_enum/mod.rs` matching the convention's Rust (.rs) file scope.' Task 3: 'Applies: task modifies `entity/src/advisory.rs` matching the convention's Rust (.rs) file scope.' Task 4 has three conventions, all with 'Applies: task modifies <specific file> matching the convention's <scope>.' Task 5 has two conventions with proper format. Task 6: 'Applies: task modifies `tests/api/advisory.rs` matching the convention's test file scope.' No 'Not applicable' annotations found anywhere. No free-form prose rationales.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature priority is 'High' (not Undefined). impact-map.md Inherited Field Values table: 'Priority | High | Propagated to all created issues (Feature priority is set and not "Undefined")'. The additional_fields JSON includes '"priority": {"name": "High"}'. summary-comment.md: 'Priority | Feature TC-9005 | High | Yes -- propagated to all created issues'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature has Fix Versions: RHTPA 2.0.0 (non-empty). No ### Jira Field Defaults section in CLAUDE.md, so scope defaults to 'both'. impact-map.md: 'Fix Versions | RHTPA 2.0.0 | Propagated to all created issues (fixVersion scope: "both" -- default, no Jira Field Defaults section configured)'. additional_fields JSON: '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 2.0.0"}]'. summary-comment.md: 'Fix Versions | Feature TC-9005 | RHTPA 2.0.0 | Yes -- propagated to all created issues (fixVersion scope: "both" -- default)'.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists and contains '## Inherited Field Values' table with: 'Priority | Feature TC-9005 | High | Yes -- propagated to all created issues' and 'Fix Versions | Feature TC-9005 | RHTPA 2.0.0 | Yes -- propagated to all created issues (fixVersion scope: "both" -- default)'. Additionally, impact-map.md contains its own '## Inherited Field Values' section with the same information.
